import pytest
from semverrange import satisfies


class TestVersionParsing:
    """Test version parsing and validation."""

    def test_valid_versions_basic(self):
        """Basic valid versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "0.0.0")
        assert satisfies("10.20.30", "10.20.30")

    def test_leading_v_allowed(self):
        """Leading v is allowed in versions."""
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "v1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("v1.2.3", "v1.2.3")

    def test_whitespace_ignored(self):
        """Surrounding whitespace is ignored."""
        assert satisfies(" 1.2.3 ", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", " 1.2.3 ")

    def test_prerelease_versions(self):
        """Versions with prerelease tags."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.1", "1.2.3-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-0.3.7", "1.2.3-0.3.7")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-x.7.z.92", "1.2.3-x.7.z.92")

    def test_build_metadata(self):
        """Build metadata is ignored when comparing."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3+build")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3+build1", "1.2.3+build2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha+build", "1.2.3-alpha")

    def test_invalid_version_missing_parts(self):
        """Invalid: missing version parts."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("v1.2", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_leading_zeros(self):
        """Invalid: leading zeros in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("01.2.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.02.3", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.03", "*")

    def test_invalid_prerelease_leading_zeros(self):
        """Invalid: leading zeros in numeric prerelease identifiers."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-01", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.01", "*")

    def test_invalid_prerelease_missing(self):
        """Invalid: missing prerelease identifiers after hyphen."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3-", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_too_many_parts(self):
        """Invalid: too many version parts."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.2.3.4", "*")

    def test_invalid_version_non_numeric(self):
        """Invalid: non-numeric MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("a.b.c", "*")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.a.3", "*")


class TestVersionComparison:
    """Test version comparison semantics."""

    def test_major_minor_patch_comparison(self):
        """Versions compared numerically by major.minor.patch."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">=2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", ">=1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.0.1", ">=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_lower_than_release(self):
        """Prerelease is lower than release with same major.minor.patch."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_vs_alphanumeric(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers are lower than alphanumeric."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", ">1.0.0-1")

    def test_prerelease_numeric_comparison(self):
        """Numeric prerelease identifiers compared numerically."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-2", ">1.0.0-1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-10", ">1.0.0-9")

    def test_prerelease_alphanumeric_comparison(self):
        """Alphanumeric prerelease identifiers compared in ASCII order."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-b", ">1.0.0-a")

    def test_prerelease_fewer_identifiers_lower(self):
        """Prerelease with fewer identifiers is lower."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha", "<1.0.0-alpha.1")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1", "<1.0.0-1.0")

    def test_prerelease_identifier_comparison_order(self):
        """Prerelease identifiers compared left to right."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-alpha.1", "<1.0.0-alpha.beta")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-1.2", "<1.0.0-1.3")


class TestExactMatches:
    """Test exact version matching."""

    def test_exact_match_simple(self):
        """Exact match for simple versions."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "=1.2.3")

    def test_exact_match_with_prerelease(self):
        """Exact match with prerelease."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-alpha")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-alpha", "1.2.3-beta")

    def test_exact_mismatch(self):
        """Exact mismatch."""
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.2")


class TestXRanges:
    """Test X-ranges and partial versions."""

    def test_wildcard_matches_any(self):
        """Wildcard matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "*")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "*")

    def test_x_matches_any(self):
        """x matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "x")
        assert satisfies("100.200.300", "x")

    def test_empty_range_matches_any(self):
        """Empty range matches any version."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "")

    def test_partial_major_minor_expansion(self):
        """1.x expands to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", "1.x")

    def test_partial_major_shorthand(self):
        """1 expands to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.7", "1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "1")

    def test_partial_minor_expansion(self):
        """1.2.x expands to >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.2.999", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", "1.2.x")

    def test_partial_minor_shorthand(self):
        """1.2 expands to >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "1.2")

    def test_gt_partial_major(self):
        """>1 and >1.x expand to >=2.0.0."""
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", ">1.x")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">1")
        assert not satisfies("1.9.9", ">1")

    def test_gt_partial_minor(self):
        """>1.2 expands to >=1.3.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.3.0", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.3.1", ">1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.4.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", ">1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.9", ">1.2")

    def test_gte_partial_minor(self):
        """>=1.2 expands to >=1.2.0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", ">=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", ">=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", ">=1.2")

    def test_lt_partial_minor(self):
        """<1.2 expands to <1.2.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.1.9", "<1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", "<1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.0", "<1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.1", "<1.2")

    def test_lte_partial_minor(self):
        """<=1.2 expands to <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "<=1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.1.0", "<=1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "<=1.2")

    def test_lte_partial_major(self):
        """<=1 expands to <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "<=1")
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "<=1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "<=1")

    def test_gt_wildcard_matches_nothing(self):
        """>* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", ">*")
        assert not satisfies("1000.0.0", ">*")

    def test_lt_wildcard_matches_nothing(self):
        """<* matches nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("0.0.0", "<*")
        assert not satisfies("1000.0.0", "<*")


class TestTildeRanges:
    """Test tilde ranges."""

    def test_tilde_with_minor_patch(self):
        """~1.2.3 expands to >=1.2.3 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.2.100", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.0", "~1.2.3")

    def test_tilde_with_minor_only(self):
        """~1.2 expands to >=1.2.0 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.100", "~1.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2")

    def test_tilde_with_major_only(self):
        """~1 expands to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "~1")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "~1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "~1")

    def test_tilde_with_zero_major(self):
        """~0.2.3 expands to >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "~0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.5", "~0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "~0.2.3")

    def test_tilde_with_prerelease(self):
        """~1.2.3-beta.2 expands to >=1.2.3-beta.2 <1.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.2.4", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.3.0", "~1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.3-beta.1", "~1.2.3-beta.2")


class TestCaretRanges:
    """Test caret ranges."""

    def test_caret_with_nonzero_major(self):
        """^1.2.3 expands to >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3")
        assert satisfies("1.999.999", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "^1.2.3")

    def test_caret_with_zero_major_nonzero_minor(self):
        """^0.2.3 expands to >=0.2.3 <0.3.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.2.3", "^0.2.3")
        assert satisfies("0.2.9", "^0.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.3.0", "^0.2.3")

    def test_caret_with_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """^0.0.3 expands to >=0.0.3 <0.0.4-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3", "^0.0.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.3")

    def test_caret_with_prerelease_nonzero_major(self):
        """^1.2.3-beta.2 expands to >=1.2.3-beta.2 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta.2", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.3-beta.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.3-beta.2")

    def test_caret_with_prerelease_zero_major_zero_minor(self):
        """^0.0.3-beta expands to >=0.0.3-beta <0.0.4-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.3-beta", "^0.0.3-beta")
        assert not satisfies("0.0.4", "^0.0.3-beta")

    def test_caret_with_partial_minor_patch(self):
        """^1.2.x and ^1.2 expand to >=1.2.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2.x")

        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "^1.2")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.2")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.2")

    def test_caret_with_partial_zero_minor(self):
        """^0.0.x and ^0.0 expand to >=0.0.0 <0.1.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0.x")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0.x")

        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.0")
        assert satisfies("0.0.5", "^0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.1.0", "^0.0")

    def test_caret_with_partial_major_only(self):
        """^1.x and ^1 expand to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1.x")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1.x")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1.x")

        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "^1")
        assert satisfies("1.9.9", "^1")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", "^1")

    def test_caret_with_zero_major_partial(self):
        """^0.x and ^0 expand to >=0.0.0 <1.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0.x")
        assert satisfies("0.9.9", "^0.x")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0.x")

        assert satisfies("0.0.0", "^0")
        assert satisfies("0.9.9", "^0")
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", "^0")


class TestHyphenRanges:
    """Test hyphen ranges."""

    def test_hyphen_full_versions(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3.4 expands to >=1.2.3 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.2.2", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_partial_left(self):
        """1.2 - 2.3.4 expands to >=1.2.0 <=2.3.4."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.0", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert satisfies("2.3.4", "1.2 - 2.3.4")
        assert not satisfies("1.1.9", "1.2 - 2.3.4")

    def test_hyphen_partial_right_minor(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2.3 expands to >=1.2.3 <2.4.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert satisfies("2.3.5", "1.2.3 - 2.3")
        assert not satisfies("2.4.0", "1.2.3 - 2.3")

    def test_hyphen_partial_right_major(self):
        """1.2.3 - 2 expands to >=1.2.3 <3.0.0-0."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert satisfies("2.9.9", "1.2.3 - 2")
        assert not satisfies("3.0.0", "1.2.3 - 2")


class TestPrereleaseMatching:
    """Test prerelease version matching rules."""

    def test_prerelease_matches_explicit_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease version matches explicit prerelease comparator."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.0.0-beta")

    def test_prerelease_matches_gt_same_base_prerelease(self):
        """1.2.3-alpha.7 matches >1.2.3-alpha.3 (same base version)."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-alpha.7", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_gt_different_base(self):
        """3.4.5-alpha.9 does NOT match >1.2.3-alpha.3 (different base)."""
        assert not satisfies("3.4.5-alpha.9", ">1.2.3-alpha.3")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_wildcard(self):
        """1.0.0-beta does NOT match *."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "*")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_lt_release(self):
        """1.0.0-beta does NOT match <2.0.0 (no prerelease in comparator)."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_lte_release_different_base(self):
        """1.0.0-beta does NOT match <=1.0.0 (different prerelease)."""
        # Note: <=1.0.0 expands to >=0.0.0 <1.0.0-0 (the -0 is a prerelease)
        # So 1.0.0-beta is NOT < 1.0.0-0, it's > 1.0.0-0
        # So actually 1.0.0-beta should NOT match <=1.0.0 because:
        # 1.0.0-beta is prerelease with base 1.0.0, but comparator is <=1.0.0
        # Let me reconsider: <=1.0.0 becomes <1.1.0-0 according to the spec
        # So 1.0.0-beta is < 1.1.0 numerically, so it should match...
        # But the prerelease rule says a prerelease only matches if
        # "at least one comparator in the set is a full version with a prerelease
        # tag and the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as the version"
        # So 1.0.0-beta needs a comparator with prerelease and 1.0.0 base
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "<=1.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_explicit_base_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches if comparator has prerelease and same base."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">1.0.0-alpha")

    def test_prerelease_no_match_range_without_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease does not match range that has no prerelease in any comparator."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0-beta", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_prerelease_matches_x_range_expansion_with_prerelease(self):
        """Prerelease matches x-range that expands to include -0."""
        # 1.x expands to >=1.0.0 <2.0.0-0
        # The <2.0.0-0 has a prerelease marker, so 1.0.0-beta should match
        assert satisfies("1.0.0-beta", "1.x")

    def test_prerelease_in_caret_range(self):
        """Prerelease matches caret range (which expands to -0 bound)."""
        # ^1.2.3 expands to >=1.2.3 <2.0.0-0
        # So 1.5.0-alpha should NOT match because no prerelease with 1.5.0 base
        # But 1.2.3-beta should match because there's a comparator with 1.2.3 and prerelease
        assert satisfies("1.2.3-beta", "^1.2.3")
        assert not satisfies("1.5.0-alpha", "^1.2.3")


class TestComparatorSets:
    """Test comparator sets (AND logic)."""

    def test_multiple_comparators_all_must_match(self):
        """All comparators in a set must match."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("0.9.9", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")
        assert not satisfies("2.0.0", ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0")

    def test_comparator_set_with_whitespace(self):
        """Whitespace separates comparators in a set."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">1.0.0  <2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">=1.0.0  <=2.0.0")

    def test_comparator_set_exact_match(self):
        """Exact match within comparator set."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.3", "1.2.3 >=1.2.3 <=1.2.3")

    def test_comparator_set_contradictory(self):
        """Contradictory comparators match nothing."""
        assert not satisfies("1.0.0", ">2.0.0 <1.0.0")


class TestUnions:
    """Test OR logic with union operator ||."""

    def test_union_first_set_matches(self):
        """Version matching first set in union."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_second_set_matches(self):
        """Version matching second set in union."""
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_no_set_matches(self):
        """Version matching neither set in union."""
        assert not satisfies("2.5.0", "1.x || >=3.0.0")

    def test_union_multiple_sets(self):
        """Union with multiple sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.0.0", "1.x || 2.x || 3.x")
        assert satisfies("2.0.0", "1.x || 2.x || 3.x")
        assert satisfies("3.0.0", "1.x || 2.x || 3.x")
        assert not satisfies("4.0.0", "1.x || 2.x || 3.x")

    def test_union_with_complex_sets(self):
        """Union with complex comparator sets."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">1.0.0 <1.9.0 || >2.0.0 <2.5.0")
        assert satisfies("2.3.0", ">1.0.0 <1.9.0 || >2.0.0 <2.5.0")


class TestWhitespaceHandling:
    """Test whitespace handling in ranges."""

    def test_operator_whitespace(self):
        """Operator may be followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", ">= 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "> 1.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "< 2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "<= 2.0.0")
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "= 1.5.0")

    def test_tilde_whitespace(self):
        """Tilde may be followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.2.5", "~ 1.2.3")

    def test_caret_whitespace(self):
        """Caret may be followed by whitespace."""
        assert satisfies("1.5.0", "^ 1.2.3")


class TestErrorHandling:
    """Test error handling for invalid inputs."""

    def test_invalid_comparator_double_operator(self):
        """Invalid: double operator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">>1.2.3")

    def test_invalid_comparator_too_many_parts(self):
        """Invalid: comparator with too many version parts."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">1.2.3.4")

    def test_invalid_comparator_non_numeric(self):
        """Invalid: comparator with non-numeric version."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">a.b.c")

    def test_invalid_comparator_leading_zeros(self):
        """Invalid: comparator with leading zeros."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">01.2.3")

    def test_invalid_range_bad_operator(self):
        """Invalid: unrecognized operator."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            satisfies("1.0.0", ">>1.0.0")

    def test_invalid_hyphen_no_spaces(self):
